Name: Some casino furniture
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever wanted to bring casino poker tables and slot machines into your home? Now it's here.

[b]This applies to the 1.6 only.[/b]
Use content patcher to add as additional furniture. You should be able to find them in the Furniture catalogue. Or use CBJ Item Spawner.

I made this because I wanted to renovate a game room. Contains two blackjack tables, slot machines from the casino; pool table, two pool cues from the bar.
Used the game's original tiles. I modified them slightly and created rotated tiles for the two blackjack tables. But for some reason, I couldn't get these two tables to rotate correctly. So I took them apart and made four different tables.
Decorative only.

I haven't encountered any problems in my testing. If there are bugs, please let me know.[/size]
